# #2099: Patch: undo and redo in the deck editor
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

In the deck editor, a card removed or added by mistake has to be found again by hand. Add Undo and Redo to the open deck: every add, remove, rename and cosmetic change is one step, Undo takes back the last one and Redo puts it back. Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z do the same, except while typing in a text field. A new edit after an Undo clears the Redo steps. The history belongs to the open deck and is gone when another deck opens or the editor closes. An undo is an ordinary edit, so it saves and syncs like any other.

### Acceptance

- Undo reverses the last add, remove, rename or cosmetic change; Redo reapplies it.
- The keyboard shortcuts work, and do nothing while a text field has focus.
- A new edit after Undo empties Redo.
- Opening another deck starts a fresh history.
- The buttons are disabled when there is nothing to undo or redo.
- Vitest covers each of the above.
